value.rationale: A complete finite étale Frobenius descent table for the natural 30 non-tractable genus-three maximal two-isogeny kernel subgroup schemes, complementing the well-studied 105 tractable kernels. A sharp and realized (1,7) case exhibits two rational polarized quotient subgroup schemes despite no rational tractable groups and no nontrivial rational Jacobian 2-torsion; extension-field cycles and the reduced kernel-scheme zeta function follow exactly. The invariant is intrinsic and relevant to arithmetic isogeny constructions without asserting a codomain Jacobian or explicit isogeny.
